name: How much does it cost to widen an interior doorway for accessibility?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to widen an interior doorway for accessibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to widen an interior doorway varies significantly based on existing construction, materials, and the extent of the work. Factors include whether the wall is load-bearing, the type of framing, and finishes required. Simple modifications like installing offset hinges are less costly, while structural changes to widen an opening will be more involved. A detailed estimate from a contractor like City Dweller, LLC, is essential after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost to widen an interior doorway depends on structural factors, materials, and labor, requiring a contractor estimate.
